/// A shape. Ünïcödé is fine.
/** Block doc. */
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct Shape<'a, T: Bound> {
    pub name: &'a str,
    pub(crate) inner: Box<Inner>,
    owned: Config,
    shared: Arc<dyn Store + Send>,
    raw: *const Node,
    map: HashMap<String, Item>,
    list: Vec<Option<Item>>,
    path: std::path::PathBuf,
    cb: fn(u8) -> u8,
    refcell: RefCell<Widget>,
    generic: T,
}

pub struct Pair(pub u32, Left, Box<Right>);

#[derive(Default)]
// plain comment drops the derive
enum Kind {
    Unit,
    Tuple(Payload, &'static str),
    Record { a: Alpha, b: Vec<Beta> },
}

#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(Deserialize, Hash))]
pub enum Wrapped<T> { A(T) }

/// Trait docs.
pub trait Sub: Base + io::Write + Clone + Iterator<Item = u8> {
    type Output;
    const LIMIT: usize = 3;
    /// No docstring for signatures.
    async fn fetch(&self, id: Id) -> Result<Thing, Error>;
    fn make() -> Self where Self: Sized;
    fn default_impl(&self, x: impl Into<String>) -> Box<dyn Render> {
        helper(x);
        Self::make()
    }
}

impl<T: Bound> Shape<'_, T> {
    pub const ZERO: u8 = 0;
    type Alias = Vec<T>;
    #[inline]
    pub unsafe fn new<U: Display + Codec, V>(name: &str, selfish: u8, f: impl Fn(u8) -> u8) -> Self
    where
        V: Store + std::fmt::Debug + Into<U> + Mapper<Key = u8>,
    {
        let s = Self { name, inner: Box::new(Inner::default()), owned: make_config(load()), ..Default::default() };
        let t = Shape::<u8> { generic: 1 };
        let c = |x: u8| other(x);
        let d = |x: u8| { nested(x) };
        let v = vec![1, 2];
        custom!(v);
        tracing::info!("hi");
        let n = x as Number;
        let m = y as u32;
        json::to_string(&s);
        Self::helper(&s).await;
        self.inner.run().await;
        s.0();
        parse::<Config>(input);
        obj.method::<u8>();
        s
    }
    fn by_ref(&self) -> &dyn Store { &self.inner }
    fn by_value(self: Box<Self>) {}
}

impl<'a> Render for &'a Shape<'a, u8> {
    fn render(&self) {}
}

impl Sub for Pair {
    type Output = Thing;
    async fn fetch(&self, id: Id) -> Result<Thing, Error> { todo!() }
    fn make() -> Self { Pair(1, Left, Box::new(Right)) }
}

type Same = Same;
type Callback = Box<dyn Fn(Event) + Send>;
pub(super) static mut COUNTER: u32 = 0;
pub(in crate::a) const NAME: &str = "x";

    #[derive(Copy)]
    struct InMod;
    mod nested { struct Hidden; }
    fn in_mod() { call(); }
    union NotSeen { a: u8 }
}
mod external;

macro_rules! custom { ($e:expr) => {} }

union Bits { int: u32, float: f32 }

fn free<'a, T>(x: &'a T) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a T> + 'a { std::iter::once(x) }
